filters.team_id: optional UUID; persisted team definition, not a text/prompt-derived guess
filters.team_run_id: optional UUID; exact persisted run; intersects all other work filters

captured_work_fields.team_id: original agent_group_runs.group_id; same tenant/project as the task

money_rule: Sum original selected member and coordinator work charge/refund entries once. Never add approved whole-team budgets or repeat a coordinator aggregate. Funding account remains attached to each work.
privacy_rule: Usage access exposes financial identity references only. No team name, brief, method body, private conversation or deliverable is read. All original scope, user-directory, session, MFA and export gates remain active.
snapshot: Captured team references are fixed with the original work-level financial snapshot; later source changes/refunds require a new snapshot.
csv: New snapshots carry team_attribution_version=1 and append four captured team columns; older encrypted snapshots retain their prior columns. Same selection and watermark.
legacy: Absent team provenance is unrecorded, never guessed as standalone. Omitted request fields remain omitted to preserve idempotency fingerprints.
qualification_scope: Native team create/preflight/approve/dispatch and synthetic settlements; no claim of new Codex/team-runtime/professional or production-provider acceptance.
